ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-14-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an adult and of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Janet Pond.
Petitioner: Grethel Pabelico Gonzalez, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for and with the Minor: Geeiah Pons Lallana. The minor's father: Glenn Lallana is also present in court.
Parties were sworn and examined.
The Minor's Father consented to the petition for change of name of the minor in open court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Grethel Gonzalez Lallana, and grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Geeiah Alfonso Lallana.
Decree signed in open court.
